name: slipway-eval
purpose: Pre-registered evaluation of execution-cost forecasts and execution strategies on Bitget tokenized US stocks (rToken spot and stock perps), graded against the recorded public order book.

cadence.sampling: mulberry32(seed ^ batchStartEpochMinutes) draws symbol, size, side uniformly with replacement

grading.bookMatch: nearest recorded books15 snapshot within 2 s of the slice time, same instrument; slices with no snapshot within 2 s are reported as ungraded, never imputed
grading.realizedCost: walk of the matched real book for the slice quantity, in bps of the arrival mid, plus the venue taker fee read from Bitget's public symbol/contract endpoints
ownImpact: shadow: each slice walks the real book as recorded (no carry-over of our own depletion) - label REPRODUCIBLE
modeled: carry-over with the estimated resilience half-life - label MODELED
no-refill bound: cumulative depletion persists within the order - label BOUND
metrics: MAE and bias of predicted p50 vs realized, by venue x session x horizon bucket [0-60s, 1-15m, 15m-6h, >6h]
head-to-head realized cost: chosen vs immediate vs twap60 per order, win rate and mean difference with bootstrap 95% CI (2000 resamples)
calibration: per venue x session multiplicative factor fitted on earlier batches, evaluated on later batches only (time split)
source ablation: share of orders whose chosen strategy changes and change in realized cost when each source is removed

reporting: All graded results are published, including strategies or sessions where Slipway loses to a baseline. Forecasts whose outcome time precedes their on-chain anchor are reported as ledger-timestamped only.
